description: The size-step vocabulary (the step IDs, their documented fraction of the grid width, and the human label) and the step width: the column span an auto-placed tile takes at each step on a cols-column grid (the fraction rounded to whole units, clamped into the grid). The Go suite asserts the server's accepted step set; the web and Android suites assert the labels and the widths (the server does not compute step widths - client rendering rules).

widths.name: an unknown step takes the default (medium) width
a missing size takes the default (medium) width
the width never exceeds the grid
rounding to whole units on a 10-column grid
